about: Higgsfield brief for the New HSK 1 game questions (core/packs/newhsk1.js), same recipe and style as yct1-pictures.json (use its style / dralingo / cast templates). Originals -> assets-library/higgsfield/2026-10-12/newhsk1/<world>/<slug>.png; web copy -> public/assets/packs/newhsk1/<world>/<slug>.webp. 78 pictures are reused from YCT 1 / HSK 1 (same word, same meaning); «caro», «barato» and the time words stay text-only on purpose.

pictures.subject: A big sister standing next to her little brother with a small gap between them (not touching); the little boy has a soft golden glow around him so he is clearly the one shown.
A big brother standing next to his little sister with a small gap between them (not touching); the little girl has a soft golden glow around her so she is clearly the one shown.
One happy little child holding a colorful pinwheel.
A smiling family of four (dad, mom, a boy and a girl) standing side by side in a row with small gaps between them (nobody touching), in front of their house.
Two cheerful best friends, a boy and a girl, standing side by side with a small gap between them (not touching), both waving and smiling.
A grand university building with columns, wide steps and green lawns, no signs and no writing.
A plate of Chinese dumplings (jiaozi) with a small dish of dipping sauce and chopsticks.
A bamboo steamer basket with fluffy white steamed buns (baozi), steam rising.
A golden loaf of bread with a few slices cut.
Two brown chicken eggs and one cracked open showing the yolk in a small bowl.
A breakfast table at sunrise: a glass of milk, eggs and steamed buns, a window behind with the rising sun (morning).
A lunch table at midday: a bowl of noodles and vegetables, a window behind with the bright sun high in the sky (noon).
A dinner table at night: rice, dishes and a warm lamp, a window behind with the moon and stars (evening).
